<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover"/>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#040507"/>
<title>Steaming Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  :root{ color-scheme: dark; }
  *{ margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html, body{ height:100%; }
  body{
    position:fixed; inset:0; overflow:hidden;
    background:#040507;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  canvas{
    display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh;
    touch-action:none;
    cursor:default;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
'use strict';

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const isReduced = () => motionQuery.matches;

/* ---------- deterministic layout ---------- */
function mulberry32(a){ return function(){ a|=0; a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0; let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a); t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t; return ((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296; }; }

const rng = mulberry32(0x9B7E2A3F);
const SCALLIONS = Array.from({length:7}, () => ({ x:(rng()*2-1)*0.52, y:(rng()*2-1)*0.44, s:0.030+rng()*0.016 }));
const OILS      = Array.from({length:9}, () => ({ x:(rng()*2-1)*0.52, y:(rng()*2-1)*0.42, r:0.016+rng()*0.022 }));
const SESAS     = Array.from({length:12}, () => ({ x:(rng()*2-1)*0.54, y:(rng()*2-1)*0.44, r:0.014+rng()*0.009, rot:rng()*TAU }));
const TOFU = [ {x:-0.36, y:-0.26, s:0.150, rot:-0.14}, {x:0.32, y:0.30, s:0.132, rot:0.12}, {x:0.04, y:-0.40, s:0.112, rot:0.30} ];
const MUSH = [ {x:0.46, y:-0.20, r:0.128, rot:-0.40}, {x:-0.12, y:0.44, r:0.146, rot:0.35}, {x:-0.50, y:0.12, r:0.104, rot:-0.18} ];
const NOODLE_COLORS = ['#e8c56c','#dfc05f','#ecca79','#ddb057','#e5c46a','#d6ac4e'];

/* ---------- state ---------- */
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, u = 0;
let t = 0;
let raf = 0, last = 0;
let motes = [];
let steam = [], ripples = [];
const mouse = { x:0, y:0, tx:0, ty:0 };
let bobEnergy = 0;
let lastRippleT = 0;

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function rr(x, y, w, h, r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function geo(){
  const px = mouse.x * u * 0.014, py = mouse.y * u * 0.009;
  const cx = W * 0.5 + px, cy = H * 0.585 + py;
  const bowlRx = u * 0.335, rimRy = bowlRx * 0.30, bowlH = bowlRx * 0.95;
  const brothRx = bowlRx * 0.885, brothRy = rimRy * 0.84;
  const brothCy = cy + rimRy * 0.10 + Math.sin(t * 1.25) * u * 0.0022;
  return { cx, cy, bowlRx, rimRy, bowlH, brothRx, brothRy, brothCy };
}

function drawShadow(x, y, rx, ry){
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,6,3,0.34)'; ctx.fill();
}

function drawTofu(x, y, s, rot){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(rot);
  rr(-s, -s * 0.86, s * 2, s * 1.46, s * 0.22);
  const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -s * 0.86, 0, s * 0.60);
  fg.addColorStop(0, '#f4eedd'); fg.addColorStop(0.55, '#ddd3b7'); fg.addColorStop(1, '#b3a684');
  ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(82,70,49,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.1; ctx.stroke();
  rr(-s * 0.66, -s * 0.66, s * 0.78, s * 0.30, s * 0.12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.38)'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMushroom(x, y, r, rot){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(rot);
  rr(-r * 0.32, -r * 0.05, r * 0.64, r * 0.66, r * 0.20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d0bf9e'; ctx.fill();
  const cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -r * 0.85, 0, r * 0.42);
  cg.addColorStop(0, '#7c573c'); cg.addColorStop(0.55, '#4e3524'); cg.addColorStop(1, '#301e13');
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r, r * 0.60, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = cg; ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-r * 0.30, -r * 0.20, r * 0.46, r * 0.20, -0.28, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,224,178,0.30)'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.10, r * 0.97, r * 0.20, 0, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(15,8,4,0.45)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawScallion(x, y, r){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7db64c'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.30; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(38,70,22,0.55)'; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r * 0.46, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#241408'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawOilDot(x, y, r){
  const og = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - r * 0.25, y - r * 0.25, 0, x, y, r);
  og.addColorStop(0, '#ffb054'); og.addColorStop(0.45, '#ff7a28'); og.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190,60,15,0.9)');
  ctx.fillStyle = og;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,220,0.75)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - r * 0.32, y - r * 0.34, r * 0.22, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
}

function drawSesame(x, y, r, rot){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r, r * 0.55, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f3e4b4'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,90,40,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.75; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- background ---------- */
function drawBackground(g, flick){
  const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  lg.addColorStop(0, '#070a0f'); lg.addColorStop(0.45, '#0b0e13'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#030405');
  ctx.fillStyle = lg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const glowX = W * 0.5 + mouse.x * W * 0.035, glowY = H * 0.26 + mouse.y * H * 0.02;
  const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(glowX, glowY, 0, glowX, glowY, Math.max(W, H) * 0.70);
  rg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,178,98,${0.15 * flick})`);
  rg.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(220,128,56,${0.065 * flick})`);
  rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = rg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const cool = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.10, H * 0.04, 0, W * 0.10, H * 0.04, Math.max(W, H) * 0.55);
  cool.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(110,140,180,0.045)'); cool.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = cool; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawMotes(){
  for (const m of motes){
    const y = ((m.y - t * m.sp) % (H + 60) + (H + 60)) % (H + 60) - 30;
    const a = m.maxA * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * m.twS + m.tw));
    ctx.fillStyle = m.warm ? `rgba(255,196,130,${a})` : `rgba(210,220,235,${a * 0.8})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, y, m.s, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawTable(g, flick){
  const tableY = g.cy + g.bowlH * 0.55;
  const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, tableY, 0, H);
  tg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(26,20,16,0)');
  tg.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(24,18,14,0.55)');
  tg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(9,7,6,0.9)');
  ctx.fillStyle = tg; ctx.fillRect(0, tableY, W, H - tableY);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(g.cx, g.cy + g.bowlH * 1.05); ctx.scale(1, 0.30);
  const sh = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, g.bowlRx * 1.55);
  sh.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,166,88,${0.13 * flick})`);
  sh.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(236,124,54,${0.05 * flick})`);
  sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sh; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, g.bowlRx * 1.55, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- bowl ---------- */
function bowlBodyPath(cx, cy, rx, ry, bh){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - rx, cy);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - rx, cy + bh * 0.74, cx - rx * 0.52, cy + bh, cx, cy + bh);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + rx * 0.52, cy + bh, cx + rx, cy + bh * 0.74, cx + rx, cy);
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBowl(g, flick){
  const { cx, cy, bowlRx, rimRy, bowlH, brothRx, brothRy, brothCy } = g;
  const k = brothRy / brothRx;

  // drop shadow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy + bowlH * 1.01); ctx.scale(1, 0.26);
  const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, bowlRx * 1.14);
  sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.66)'); sg.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.30)'); sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, bowlRx * 1.14, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // ---- broth contents (clipped to broth ellipse) ----
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, brothCy, brothRx, brothRy, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.clip();

  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, brothCy - brothRy * 0.25, brothRx * 0.06, cx, brothCy, brothRx * 1.08);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#472a17'); bg.addColorStop(0.5, '#2d1a0d'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#180d06');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fillRect(cx - brothRx, brothCy - brothRy, brothRx * 2, brothRy * 2);

  // rotating chili-oil sheen
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++){
    const a = i * 1.05 + t * 0.055;
    const r0 = brothRx * (0.28 + 0.42 * ((i * 0.37) % 1));
    const ox = Math.cos(a) * r0, oy = Math.sin(a) * r0 * k * 0.92;
    const al = 0.075 + 0.025 * Math.sin(t * 0.8 + i * 1.4);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx + ox, brothCy + oy, brothRx * 0.36, brothRx * 0.36 * k * 0.55, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,116,34,${al})`; ctx.fill();
  }

  // ripples
  for (const r of ripples){
    const alpha = 0.5 * (1 - r.life / r.dur);
    if (alpha <= 0) continue;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx + r.nx * brothRx, brothCy + r.ny * brothRy, Math.max(0.01, r.r) * brothRx, r.r * brothRy, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,214,150,${alpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.0032; ctx.stroke();
  }

  // noodles
  const bob = Math.sin(t * 1.05) * brothRx * 0.006;
  const wAmp = brothRx * (0.040 + bobEnergy * 0.045);
  const lw = u * 0.0162;
  const strands = 6;
  for (let i = 0; i < strands; i++){
    const off = (i - (strands - 1) / 2) * brothRx * 0.135;
    const phase = i * 1.93;
    const lo = -brothRx * 0.72, hi = brothRx * 0.72, step = brothRx * 0.045;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = lo; x <= hi; x += step){
      const y = off + Math.sin(x * 0.045 + t * 1.35 + phase) * wAmp
                   + Math.cos(x * 0.021 - t * 0.9 + phase * 1.7) * wAmp * 0.6 + bob;
      const ypx = brothCy + y * k;
      if (x === lo) ctx.moveTo(cx + x, ypx); else ctx.lineTo(cx + x, ypx);
    }
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c89a43'; ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.18; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = NOODLE_COLORS[i % NOODLE_COLORS.length]; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(0, -u * 0.0042);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,240,190,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.32; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // toppings
  for (const o of OILS) drawOilDot(cx + o.x * brothRx, brothCy + o.y * brothRy, o.r * brothRx);
  for (const s of SESAS) drawSesame(cx + s.x * brothRx, brothCy + s.y * brothRy, s.r * brothRx, s.rot);
  for (let i = 0; i < SCALLIONS.length; i++){
    const s = SCALLIONS[i];
    drawScallion(cx + s.x * brothRx, brothCy + s.y * brothRy + Math.sin(t * 1.1 + i * 2.1) * u * 0.0016, s.s * brothRx);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < MUSH.length; i++){
    const m = MUSH[i];
    const mx = cx + m.x * brothRx, my = brothCy + m.y * brothRy + Math.sin(t * 1.15 + i * 1.9) * u * 0.0018;
    drawShadow(mx, my + m.r * brothRx * 0.5, m.r * brothRx * 1.15, m.r * brothRx * 0.34);
    drawMushroom(mx, my, m.r * brothRx, m.rot);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < TOFU.length; i++){
    const tf = TOFU[i];
    const fx = cx + tf.x * brothRx, fy = brothCy + tf.y * brothRy + Math.sin(t * 1.05 + i * 2.6) * u * 0.0016;
    drawShadow(fx, fy + tf.s * brothRx * 0.72, tf.s * brothRx * 1.05, tf.s * brothRx * 0.34);
    drawTofu(fx, fy, tf.s * brothRx, tf.rot);
  }

  // inner broth edge shadow
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, brothCy, brothRx, brothRy, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6,3,2,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.009; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore(); // unclip

  // ---- bowl body ----
  bowlBodyPath(cx, cy, bowlRx, rimRy, bowlH);
  const bodyG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy, 0, cy + bowlH);
  bodyG.addColorStop(0, '#4a565d'); bodyG.addColorStop(0.16, '#323b41'); bodyG.addColorStop(0.72, '#161b1f'); bodyG.addColorStop(1, '#0c0f12');
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyG; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; ctx.stroke();

  ctx.save();
  bowlBodyPath(cx, cy, bowlRx, rimRy, bowlH); ctx.clip();
  const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - bowlRx * 0.66, 0, cx - bowlRx * 0.05, 0);
  hg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,236,210,0)');
  hg.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255,236,210,${0.15 * (0.75 + 0.25 * flick)})`);
  hg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,236,210,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = hg; ctx.fillRect(cx - bowlRx, cy - rimRy, bowlRx * 1.7, bowlH + rimRy * 2);
  const wg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + bowlRx * 0.42, cy + bowlH * 0.74, 0, cx + bowlRx * 0.42, cy + bowlH * 0.74, bowlRx * 0.8);
  wg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,150,70,${0.15 * flick})`); wg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = wg; ctx.fillRect(cx - bowlRx, cy - rimRy, bowlRx * 2, bowlH + rimRy * 2);
  ctx.restore();

  // ---- rim ----
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, bowlRx, rimRy, 0, 0, TAU);
  const rimG = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - bowlRx, 0, cx + bowlRx, 0);
  rimG.addColorStop(0, '#6d7478'); rimG.addColorStop(0.35, '#c8c5bb'); rimG.addColorStop(0.55, '#ece5d6');
  rimG.addColorStop(0.8, '#88867f'); rimG.addColorStop(1, '#494e52');
  ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.0155; ctx.strokeStyle = rimG; ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, bowlRx * 0.945, rimRy * 0.88, 0, Math.PI, TAU);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(5,3,2,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.007; ctx.stroke();
}

/* ---------- atmosphere ---------- */
function drawVignette(){
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.52, Math.min(W, H) * 0.34, W / 2, H * 0.52, Math.max(W, H) * 0.82);
  vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)');
  ctx.fillStyle = vg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawSteam(g){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  const bendX = mouse.x * u * 0.085;
  for (const p of steam){
    const rise = p.life * u * 0.42;
    const x = g.cx + p.nx * g.brothRx + Math.sin(t * p.swayF + p.phase) * p.swayA * (0.35 + p.life) + bendX * Math.pow(p.life, 1.5);
    const y = g.brothCy - g.brothRy * 0.15 - rise;
    const s = p.size * (0.5 + p.life * 2.1);
    const a = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, p.life)) * p.maxA;
    if (a <= 0.002 || s < 1) continue;
    const gr = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, s);
    gr.addColorStop(0, `rgba(231,227,238,${a})`);
    gr.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(226,221,233,${a * 0.45})`);
    gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(226,221,233,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = gr;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, s, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStaticSteam(g){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++){
    const fx = (i - 2) / 2;
    const bx = g.cx + fx * g.brothRx * 0.38;
    const topY = g.brothCy - u * 0.32 - (i % 2) * u * 0.035;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(bx, g.brothCy - g.brothRy * 0.2);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      bx + Math.sin(i * 2.4) * u * 0.030, g.brothCy - u * 0.12,
      bx + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * u * 0.055, g.brothCy - u * 0.22,
      bx + Math.sin(i * 1.3) * u * 0.065, topY
    );
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(228,224,236,0.055)';
    ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.105; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(228,224,236,0.10)';
    ctx.lineWidth = u * 0.042; ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- main render ---------- */
function render(){
  const g = geo();
  const flick = isReduced() ? 0.95
    : (0.88 + 0.09 * Math.sin(t * 6.7) + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 11.3 + 1.7) + 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + 0.6));
  drawBackground(g, flick);
  drawMotes();
  drawTable(g, flick);
  drawBowl(g, flick);
  drawVignette();
  if (isReduced()) drawStaticSteam(g); else drawSteam(g);
}

/* ---------- steam lifecycle ---------- */
function spawnSteam(nx, boost){
  const rate = boost ? (0.24 + Math.random() * 0.10) : (0.15 + Math.random() * 0.085);
  steam.push({
    nx: nx == null ? (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.45 : nx + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.18,
    life: 0, rate,
    size: u * ((boost ? 0.095 : 0.072) + Math.random() * 0.045),
    swayA: u * (0.018 + Math.random() * 0.028),
    swayF: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.9,
    phase: Math.random() * TAU,
    maxA: boost ? 0.13 + Math.random() * 0.07 : 0.085 + Math.random() * 0.075
  });
}

function prefillSteam(){
  steam.length = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 13; i++){
    spawnSteam();
    steam[steam.length - 1].life = Math.random();
  }
}

function initMotes(){
  motes = [];
  const n = Math.max(14, Math.round(u / 34));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
    motes.push({
      x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H,
      s: 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.7, sp: 6 + Math.random() * 14,
      tw: Math.random() * TAU, twS: 0.3 + Math.random() * 1.2,
      maxA: 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.12, warm: Math.random() < 0.7
    });
  }
}

/* ---------- loop ---------- */
function frame(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, ((now - last) / 1000) || 0);
  last = now; t += dt;
  mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4);
  mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4);
  bobEnergy *= Math.pow(0.22, dt);
  if (steam.length < 17 && Math.random() < dt * 3.1) spawnSteam();
  for (let i = steam.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){ steam[i].life += dt * steam[i].rate; if (steam[i].life >= 1) steam.splice(i, 1); }
  for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    const r = ripples[i]; r.life += dt; r.r += dt * 0.5;
    if (r.life >= r.dur) ripples.splice(i, 1);
  }
  render();
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function startLoop(){ if (raf) return; last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
function stopLoop(){ if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }

function onMotionChange(){
  steam.length = 0; ripples.length = 0;
  if (isReduced()){
    stopLoop(); t = 1.35;
    mouse.x = mouse.y = mouse.tx = mouse.ty = 0;
    render();
  } else {
    t = 0; prefillSteam(); startLoop();
  }
}
motionQuery.addEventListener('change', onMotionChange);

/* ---------- events ---------- */
window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
  if (isReduced()) return;
  mouse.tx = (e.clientX / W) * 2 - 1;
  mouse.ty = (e.clientY / H) * 2 - 1;
  const g = geo();
  const nx = (e.clientX - g.cx) / g.brothRx, ny = (e.clientY - g.brothCy) / g.brothRy;
  const now = performance.now();
  if (nx * nx + ny * ny <= 1 && now - lastRippleT > 170){
    ripples.push({ nx, ny, r: 0.06, life: 0, dur: 1.6 });
    lastRippleT = now;
  }
}, { passive: true });

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  if (isReduced()) return;
  mouse.tx = (e.clientX / W) * 2 - 1;
  mouse.ty = (e.clientY / H) * 2 - 1;
  const g = geo();
  let nx = (e.clientX - g.cx) / g.brothRx, ny = (e.clientY - g.brothCy) / g.brothRy;
  const d = Math.hypot(nx, ny);
  if (d > 1){ nx /= d; ny /= d; }
  ripples.push({ nx, ny, r: 0.05, life: 0, dur: 1.9 });
  bobEnergy = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnSteam(nx, true);
}, { passive: true });

function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.max(2, Math.round(W * DPR));
  canvas.height = Math.max(2, Math.round(H * DPR));
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  u = Math.min(W, H);
  initMotes();
  ripples.length = 0;
  if (isReduced()){ steam.length = 0; render(); }
  else prefillSteam();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
resize();
if (isReduced()){ t = 1.35; render(); }
else startLoop();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
